content_sections.heading: RGKMCH Molecular Biologist Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the RGKMCH Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download RGKMCH Molecular Biologist Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Molecular Biologist: Post Graduate degree in Microbiology or Biotechnology from any Govt. recognized University (including Integrated PG degree). Desirable: Working experience in Molecular Diagnostic assays in infectious diseases (Real-Time PCR) with at least three years (03) lab experience in healthcare settings.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Molecular Biologist: Maximum age limit is 40 years.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Molecular Biologist: Consolidated salary of Rs. 40,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for RGKMCH Molecular Biologist Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the R.G. Kar Medical College recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the post of Molecular Biologist. This is a contract-based position.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Molecular Biologist post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Molecular Biologist position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for the Molecular Biologist role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree in Microbiology or Biotechnology from a government-recognized university. Experience in molecular diagnostic assays is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for candidates applying for the Molecular Biologist post is 40 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Molecular Biologist position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the Molecular Biologist post is scheduled for 18 September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the venue for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be held at R.G. Kar Medical College, Kolkata, West Bengal, 700004.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original and self-attested photocopies of government photo ID proof, age proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and two passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.
